blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Columnist Ramon Tulfo on Thursday admitted that his expose claiming that former House Speaker Martin Romualdez could go in and out of jail was erroneous. READ: Court to BJMP: Did you let Romualdez out? “I was fed the wrong report that former Speaker Martin Romualdez could go in and out of jail,” Tulfo’s Facebook post reads. Tulfo also said reports that Romualdez was “riding in an ambulance and the brownouts taking place so he would not be seen going out and coming back in” were not true. “No such thing happened when the facts started coming in yesterday.
